dedupe_keys.name: geometrical digital twins of the as built microstructure of three leaf stone masonry walls with laser scanning

description: Geometrical digital twins of the as-built microstructure of three-leaf stone masonry walls with laser scanning is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Savvas Saloustros et al. Research on irregular stone masonry walls is hampered by the lack of detailed geometrical models of their internal micro-structure, i.e. the shape and size of each stone and its position within the wall. Without such a geometric digital twin of walls tested in the laboratory, it is difficult to evaluate the accuracy of existing numerical simulation techniques. Coverage: a single site or case study; published in 2023. Formats: Point cloud. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
